chosen.title: feet in high heels of a woman walking down steps
chosen.why: Feet and stone steps only, low warm sunlight, muted grey/beige stone; one foot lands (~1.6s) and the next comes down and lands (~3.5s) inside the 0.6-3.8 window, so the cut carries a step-pause-step rhythm. No text or logos. Downsides: low side angle rather than top-down POV, and stiletto heels read slightly fashion-stock; background building is soft and cropable.

alternates.why: Legs in dark trousers on glass hotel stairs, faceless, steady rhythm; but the person walks UP and the space is cold high-key white, off the warm film tone.
Feet on pink stone steps, faceless; from 4.5s a single person in jeans and boots descends. Harsh midday sun, several people in frame, saturated blue jeans - usable only in a pinch.

notes: Mixkit has no true top-down POV of one's own feet on stairs. Searched: walking down stairs feet, feet on stairs, stairs shoes close up, legs going down stairs (0 hits), stairs, staircase, walking feet. Rejected: 770 (woman's face visible, red wall), 49513 (running up, heels), escalator clips 31451/31418/31421 (escalator, teal jeans). Recommend centre crop and a desaturate/warm grade on 35987 to hide the heel glamour; if the heels feel wrong for the character, fall back to the cream paper card.
